rename_proof: The GeoTIFF is byte-identical before and after the rename (SHA-256 c122a9ff37abf5512bbddf39c9d55c60effb2229ed992d959e357ffb804a50f3 both times, 132,513 bytes): a TIFF does not store its own filename, so an identifier-only rename cannot change it. Only the ZIP's SHA-256 changed, because a ZIP stores its inner member's filename. The submission name and note live in the sidecar JSON and on the site, never in the raster bytes. The pixel pattern, the 37,654 emitted cells and the catalogue-distance statistics are therefore provably unchanged, not merely asserted to be.
